messages:
Iris: Quick heads-up — ran onboarding eval for vector model 'boa-v2' with int8 per-channel quant. See recall@10 drop vs FP16.

Jamal: oh no how big?

Iris: Baseline FP16 recall@10=0.84, int8=0.78 on wiki-holdout (n=50k). Loss >6 pts, centroid drift seen in UMAP. pings: @Priya @Marta

Priya: Can you paste the eval command + seed?

Iris: Sure: ```./run_eval.sh --model boa-v2 --quant int8 --dataset wiki_holdout --k 10 --seed 42 --batch 512```
logs: ```Recall@10: 0.78 (±0.002)``` Also sample nearests show semantic swaps.

Marta: Did you run per-channel vs per-tensor? maybe symmetric clamp?

Iris: Tried per-channel. Per-tensor was worse (0.74). Tried clamp=/2 scaling -> slight improvement 0.79 but still below FP16.

Jamal: Any differences in embedding L2 norms?

Iris: Mean L2 FP16=1.02, int8=0.88. Distribution shift histogram: https://console.redwood.ai/d/embeds/boa-v2/ (dashboard)

Theo: Could be activation outliers. Can you dump top 100 tokens with highest norm diff?

Iris: Dumped, small sample:
- "paris" -> FP16 neighbors: ["france","paris","louvre"]
- "paris" -> int8 neighbors: ["louvre","paris","pricing"]
- "django" -> FP16: ["python","framework","django"]
- "django" -> int8: ["framework","django","music"]

eval-bot: Auto-eval finished: clustering ARI FP16=0.61, int8=0.55; silhouette FP16=-0.12 -> int8=-0.19

Priya: Let's run sensitivity ablation: 1) quantize last linear only 2) layerwise clamp 3) dynamic KMeans on centroids. I'll spawn runs.

Marta: Also try isotropic rescaling: scale INT8 embeddings to match FP16 mean L2 before nearest search (cheap).

Iris: Good plan. I'll open a ticket with results and link experiments. For quick prod guard, recommend pinning to FP16 for now.

Jamal: :thumbsup: assign ticket ML-4521

Iris: Ticket ML-4521 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-4521. I'll post updates.
